import sys
from html.parser import HTMLParser
class P(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.inputs = []
        self.forms = 0
        self.buttons = 0
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a = dict(attrs)
        if tag == "form":
            self.forms += 1
        elif tag == "input":
            self.inputs.append(a)
            if (a.get("type") or "").lower() == "submit":
                self.buttons += 1
        elif tag == "button":
            self.buttons += 1
    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag
p = P()
p.feed(open("login.html", encoding="utf-8").read())
has_u = any(i.get("name") == "u" and (i.get("type") or "text").lower() != "password" for i in p.inputs)
has_p = any(i.get("name") == "p" and (i.get("type") or "").lower() == "password" for i in p.inputs)
sys.exit(0 if p.forms >= 1 and has_u and has_p and p.buttons >= 1 else 1)
